task.title: Refresh the source revision and dependencies
task.shortdesc: Move the checkout to an approved newer revision and reinstall the Python environment without hiding dependency or worktree failures.

prereq.p: The pre-update evidence set exists, the previous revision is recorded, and an approved target branch, tag, or commit is known.

context.p: BPM source updates are Git and Python-environment operations performed in the existing checkout. The procedure does not install a packaged distribution, native service, or production upgrade manager.

info.p: Stop if local changes are unexpected. Preserve user-owned or site-owned changes instead of overwriting them.

step.cmd: Move to the approved newer source revision.

info.p: Record the target revision and compare it with the approved change ticket or release note.

info.codeblock: source .venv/bin/activate python -m pip install --upgrade pip pip install -e ".[dev]"
info.p: Use the existing .venv unless the update note explicitly requires rebuilding it. Record dependency failures before changing the database.

step.cmd: Stop on unresolved source or dependency failures.

info.note: If checkout, dependency installation, or virtual-environment activation fails, do not run migrations. Return to the recorded previous revision only if the database has not been changed, then reinstall the previous dependency set and re-run the pre-update smoke checks.

result.p: The checkout and Python environment are on the approved target revision, or the update has stopped before database changes.

postreq.p: Run database migrations and documentation checks only after the dependency refresh succeeds.
